Hey team — I started the supplier registration in Ariba this morning. Two quick things I ran into:

- Ariba requires a supplier admin email. Please use vendor-admin@redwood.com (I'll monitor it).
- The registration portal asks for the default PO acceptance terms. Vertex's form shows a net-45 term. If Vertex can accept net-30, that avoids a separate payment exception request.

Action items:
- Maria: confirm whether Vertex will accept net-30 or if we should mark net-45 in Ariba. If net-45, I will raise an internal payment exception ticket.
- Lauren: please upload the W-9 and confirm remit address here or to vendor-admin@redwood.com.

I attached a screenshot of the Ariba confirmation page showing the missing admin email.

Thanks,

Thanks Ben — we can accept net-30 in the portal. We'll mark the Order Form accordingly once we settle the MSA language.

Regarding the MSA: our legal team redlined two clauses they consider non-starters for regulated suppliers (Sections 7 and 11 in their markup). I attached their redline PDF. Can Redwood legal provide proposed language we can accept or confirm an escalated review to our GC?

Also, we prefer invoices to reference the Ariba PO number and include the Redwood vendor code once assigned. Please confirm you will include the PO mapping in your finance notes.

Best,
Maria

Maria — good news on net-30, thanks. Summary update from our side after internal sync:

- Legal (Lauren copied for routing to contracts) will respond to your redlines by end of day Friday. If the items in Sections 7/11 are material, we expect to propose narrow language that preserves Vertex's risk position while keeping a standard Redwood clause set.
- Ben will finish the Ariba supplier admin invite today; vendor-admin@redwood.com will receive the registration confirmation and we will forward the vendor ID once created.
- Lauren to share W-9 via secure link (we won't email the tax form). Expect that to be posted to the Ariba document repository.

Can you confirm whether Vertex requires a purchase order to be issued before any onboarding work starts, or if a signed Order Form + Ariba vendor record is sufficient? That will determine whether we need a PO number for the first invoice.

Thanks — Sofia
